Shubhali qatorlar (bir xil shifr, lekin.en: Doubtful lines (same code but different K=/thickness; several source blocks into one line; another section; different unit) must not enter the act without PTO confirmation — check each one.

Moslash hisoboti: shubhali {s}, xato {x}.en: Matching report: doubtful {s}, errors {x} — do not write silently until PTO has checked

Birlik farqli zamena: asl qatorning qanc.en: Replacement in a different unit: enter how much of the original line ({birlik}) it replaces — otherwise the remainder goes negative.

Almashtiriladigan hajm asl qator hajmida.en: The replaced quantity exceeds the original line quantity.

Asl qatorning qancha hajmini almashtirad.ru: Какой объём исходной строки заменяет ({birlik}, обязательно — единица отличается)
Asl qatorning qancha hajmini almashtirad.en: How much of the original line it replaces ({birlik}, required — unit differs)

Zamena birligi asl qatorniki bilan bir x.en: The replacement unit differs from the original: the plan is based on the replaced quantity of the original line, not on one F2 quantity.

birlik farqli zamena — alohida, almashti.ru: замена в другой единице — создайте отдельно, с заменяемым объёмом
birlik farqli zamena — alohida, almashti.en: replacement in a different unit — create it separately, with the replaced quantity
